execution_frontier.name: Persisted R1 flow-restored hybrid machine promotion check
execution_frontier.summary: R1 completed 128 batches but failed its original strict waveform gate 104/125. A corrected unique-identity rerun reproduced that result exactly. Multi-seed and noise diagnostics showed broad stochastic low-level instability. The acoustic-reset diagnostic now isolates the instability to R1 drift in model_g.flow: restoring only the pristine warm-start flow produces 125/125 on all three tested seed schedules, while decoder-only restoration does not. Before any R2 training, persist an R1-flow-restored hybrid checkpoint and require 125/125 across five deterministic seed schedules with 125 uniquely persisted primary-gate WAVs.

r1_seed_robustness.interpretation: Original R1 is broadly seed-sensitive rather than containing a fixed set of permanently dead utterances.

noise_ablation.interpretation: Inference tuning alone is not a valid repair; amplitude is strongly latent-noise dependent.

acoustic_reset_diagnosis.primary_conclusion: R1 drift in model_g.flow is the identified cause of the stochastic low-level failures. Decoder restoration alone does not fix the problem. Flow-only restoration is the minimum-change successful intervention and preserves R1 decoder plus DWC text-side learning.
acoustic_reset_diagnosis.piper_transfer_boundary: The official vocoder warm-start transfers model_g.dec, model_g.enc_q and model_g.flow. R1 had optimized all model_g parameters, including the previously good flow.

operations: copy only model_g.flow.* from the exact verified warm-start into the completed R1 checkpoint
persist the hybrid checkpoint with provenance and SHA-256
run the corrected unique 125-row machine gate across five deterministic seed schedules
persist 125 uniquely identified WAVs for the primary seed schedule
require every row to pass all five schedules before marking machine-promotion-ready
next_safe_execution.decision_after: If the persisted hybrid is PROMOTION_READY, authorize a separately governed R2 that starts from that hybrid and freezes model_g.flow.*. Add row-level/quantile amplitude protection so median-only collapse detection cannot miss heterogeneous failures.

prohibited_forward_paths: enter R2 before the persisted flow-restored hybrid passes its strengthened machine check
train or update model_g.flow before explicit post-promotion authorization
use a lucky stochastic seed as acceptance
treat machine waveform acceptance as human CNS perceptual acceptance

settled_architecture.frontend: DWC/PSS/CNS to engine-independent exact custom phoneme IDs; no English G2P at acoustic boundary
